contracts: Queue request data is caller-controlled wire data until the user proxy validates the request length and offsets
QueueCallbackWorker2 may read a msgid only after data_len is at least sizeof(ULONG)
USER_OPEN_FILE_REQ FileNameOffset must point inside the received request buffer after the fixed header on a WCHAR boundary to a contained NUL-terminated string
USER_SHELL_EXEC_REQ FileNameOffset must point inside the received request buffer after the fixed header on a WCHAR boundary to a contained NUL-terminated string
USER_OPEN_FILE_REQ EaBufferOffset is optional, but a nonzero EA buffer range must stay inside the received request buffer
File_NtCreateFileProxy copies exactly ObjectName Length bytes from the counted UNICODE_STRING source and synthesizes the NUL terminator locally
The fix does not change EFS policy, path-list matching, queue ownership, requested access, shell verb choice, or broker handle duplication
runtime_gate: Windows service/DLL build, malformed USERPROXY queue request smokes for short msgid/path/EA ranges, and positive EFS USER_OPEN_FILE plus BreakoutDocument smokes.
